description: Defines shared control block structure and constants for Android's AudioTrack component, including timing, underrun, and buffer management details.

classes.name: audio_track_cblk_t
classes.description: Shared control block structure for managing audio track buffers and states in Android's audio framework.

methods.name: audio_track_cblk_t
methods.description: Constructor for the shared control block structure.

methods.name: stepUser
methods.description: Advances the user pointer by a specified frame count.

methods.name: stepServer
methods.description: Advances the server pointer by a specified frame count.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer at a given offset.

methods.name: framesAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of frames available for reading.

methods.name: framesAvailable_l
methods.description: Returns the number of frames available, with lock held.

methods.name: framesReady
methods.description: Returns the number of frames ready for playback.

methods.name: tryLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock without blocking.

methods.name: setSendLevel
methods.description: Sets the send level (volume) for the audio track.

methods.name: setVolumeLR
methods.description: Sets the left/right channel volume levels.
